items.title: pentest-ai-agents – 28 Claude Code Subagents for Penetration Testing
items.description: A new open-source toolkit called pentest-ai-agents is redefining how security professionals leverage AI in penetration testing workflows, transforming Anthropic’s Claude Code into a fully specialized offensive security research assistant powered by 28 domain-specific subagents.
